source: docs/dataset-spec.md §2 (EGY markers «عايز/عاوز», «عايزة/عايزه») and the Arabizi examples 3ayez, 3ayza
notes: The spec defines no mechanical gender check; this is a heuristic on the speaker's 'want' participle only, reported as warnings.
«عايزه/عاوزه» are skipped: the final ه is either the feminine ending or the 'it' clitic on the masculine form.
Matching keeps ة distinct from ه (light folding).
